title: Refraction diagram sheet
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 4 (Refraction diagram sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 4: Refraction: why a straw looks bent. To understand that light bends when it passes from one transparent material into another

picture.draw: Draw and label: Refraction diagram sheet

questions.q: Explain why a pool looks shallower than it is.
questions.a: Light from the bottom bends at the surface, so the bottom looks higher
questions.model: Where does the light start? The pool floor. What happens at the surface? It bends. What does the brain think? The light came straight, so the floor looks higher.

questions.q: Name two transparent materials light refracts through.
Is refraction the same as reflection?
questions.a: No: reflection bounces, refraction bends through

questions.q: Do the coin trick and the straw test. Draw and label both with the word 'refraction'.
questions.a: Two labelled diagrams showing light bending at the water surface
questions.model: Teacher does the coin trick on camera: coin in an empty cup, move back until it is hidden, pour water slowly: it reappears.

questions.q: Write a sentence comparing reflection and refraction.
questions.a: Reflection is light bouncing off a surface; refraction is light bending as it passes through into a new material.

questions.q: Why does a fish look nearer the surface than it really is?
questions.a: Light from the fish bends at the surface, so it seems to come from higher up.

questions.q: Light bending into a new material is...
Big question: is the straw really broken?
questions.a: No: light bends as it leaves water, so it looks broken.
